description: This file defines the class CompatTabEclair, which is a concrete implementation of the CompatTab interface for Android API level Eclair. It manages tab properties such as text, icon, fragment, and callback listener, providing methods to set and retrieve these attributes.

classes.name: CompatTabEclair
classes.description: A concrete implementation of the CompatTab interface tailored for Android Eclair, managing tab text, icon, fragment, and listener.

methods.name: CompatTabEclair
methods.description: Constructor initializing the CompatTabEclair with activity context and tab tag.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the tab's text using a resource ID.

methods.name: setIcon
methods.description: Sets the tab's icon drawable using a resource ID.

methods.name: setTabListener
methods.description: Assigns a callback listener to the tab.

methods.name: setFragment
methods.description: Associates a Fragment instance with the tab.

methods.name: getFragment
methods.description: Retrieves the Fragment associated with the tab.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the text set on the tab.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Retrieves the icon drawable set on the tab.

methods.name: getTab
methods.description: Returns null; placeholder for tab object.

methods.name: getCallback
methods.description: Retrieves the callback listener for the tab.
